Histórico: Imperio alemán, Austria-Hungr: Historical: German Empire, Austria-Hungary (here Austria and Hungary) and Italy, signed on 20 May 1882. It expired in 1915, when Italy left. On the map they are shown over current borders.

Fuerza militar conjunta de Benín, Camerú: Joint military force of Benin, Cameroon, Chad and Nigeria against the Boko Haram insurgency, headquartered in N'Djamena (Chad). It began in 1994 as a Nigerian force; Niger was a member until it withdrew in 2025.
Histórico: alianza militar y política en: Historical: military and political alliance between Nazi Germany and the Kingdom of Italy, signed in Berlin on 22 May 1939. In practice it ended in 1943 with the Armistice of Cassibile. On the map they are shown over current borders.
Histórico: tratado firmado en Atenas el: Historical: treaty signed in Athens on 9 February 1934 by Greece, Romania, Turkey and Yugoslavia to keep the post-World War I status quo. It ended with the Axis invasion of Yugoslavia on 6 April 1941. On the map they are shown over current borders.
Acuerdo de defensa y seguridad del Carib: Defence and security agreement of the eastern Caribbean, created on 29 October 1982 and based in Barbados. Members: Antigua and Barbuda, Barbados, Dominica, Saint Lucia and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines (1982), Saint Kitts and Nevis (1983), Grenada (1985) and Guyana (2022).

Alianza regional de Francia, Alemania y: Regional alliance of France, Germany and Poland created in 1991 in the German city of Weimar to cooperate on cross-border and European issues. Since 2022 its leaders also meet to coordinate security in the face of the war in Ukraine.
Alianza regional de Lituania, Polonia y: Regional alliance of Lithuania, Poland and Ukraine created on 28 July 2020 to strengthen military, political, economic and cultural cooperation and to support Ukraine's integration into the EU and NATO. Its military arm is the joint Lithuanian–Polish–Ukrainian Brigade (LITPOLUKRBRIG).
Tratado de Asociación Estratégica Integr: Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership signed in Pyongyang on 18 June 2024 by Kim Jong Un and Vladimir Putin, in force since 4 December 2024. Its Article 4 obliges each party to provide immediate military assistance if the other suffers an armed invasion.
Una de las cinco fuerzas regionales de l: One of the five regional forces of the African Union's African Standby Force, with military, police and civilian components for peace support operations. Ten members according to Wikipedia (figure as of January 2018); South Sudan was listed as an observer.
Histórico: serie de acuerdos firmados el: Historical: a series of agreements signed on 8 April 1904 between the United Kingdom and France that markedly improved Anglo-French relations. It was the basis of the Triple Entente with Russia (1907). Shown on today's borders.
Histórico: Tratado de Amistad y No Agres: Historical: Portuguese–Spanish Treaty of Friendship and Non-Aggression, signed in Lisbon on 17 March 1939 by Salazar and Nicolás Franco and ratified on 25 March. Neither party would assist an aggressor against the other; reinforced in 1940 and the basis of the neutral 'Iberian Bloc' of 1942 during the Second World War.

En vigor desde el 23 de junio de 1960 (s: In force since 23 June 1960 (it replaced the 1951 treaty). It allows U.S. bases in Japan and commits both to defend each other if one is attacked in the territories administered by Japan.
Firmado el 1 de octubre de 1953, dos mes: Signed on 1 October 1953, two months after the Korean War armistice. Mutual aid against an external armed attack and U.S. forces stationed in South Korea.
Firmado el 30 de agosto de 1951 en Washi: Signed on 30 August 1951 in Washington; an attack in the Pacific on either would endanger the peace of both, who would act together.
Tratado de Amistad, Cooperación y Asiste: Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance signed in Beijing on 11 July 1961 by Zhou Enlai and Kim Il Sung. It is China's only defence pact.
Pacto de Defensa Mutua Pakistán–Arabia S: Pakistan–Saudi Arabia Strategic Mutual Defence Agreement (2025)
Firmado el 17 de septiembre de 2025 en R: Signed on 17 September 2025 in Riyadh by Mohammed bin Salman and Shehbaz Sharif: any aggression against one is treated as aggression against both.
La alianza más antigua del mundo que sig: The oldest alliance in the world still in force: it began with the Treaty of Windsor of 1386 between England and Portugal (already allied by the 1373 treaty). Today it links the United Kingdom and Portugal.
Dos tratados de cooperación en defensa y: Two defence and security cooperation treaties between the United Kingdom and France, signed on 2 November 2010 (Combined Joint Expeditionary Force, nuclear cooperation at Valduc and Aldermaston). Updated on 10 July 2025.
Tratado de defensa mutua firmado en octu: Mutual defence treaty signed in October 2025: both countries are bound to assist each other if one is attacked, and their armed forces become integrated. "Pukpuk" means crocodile.
Histórico: alianza de los imperios alemá: Historical: alliance of the German, Russian and Austro-Hungarian empires (here Austria and Hungary), formed by Bismarck in 1873 to keep a balance of power in Europe. It lasted until 1887. Shown on the map over present-day borders.
Histórico: alianza defensiva entre Alema: Historical: defensive alliance between Germany and Austria-Hungary (here Austria and Hungary), signed on 7 October 1879. Each promised help if Russia attacked the other. Shown on the map over present-day borders.
